therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Androgen deprivation therapy combined with microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of androgen-driven tumor growth and disruption of cell division
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Clinically asymptomatic prostate cancer patients with rising PSA

biomarker_changes: PSA progression used as primary endpoint
subgroup_findings: Testosterone specific evaluable population showed similar results
safety_signals: Treatment discontinuation due to AEs (35/196 vs 1/204)
results.dose_information: Docetaxel 75 mg/m² IV every 3 weeks up to 10 cycles, Leuprolide 22.5 mg SC every 12 weeks up to 18 months, Bicalutamide 50 mg PO daily for first 4 weeks

context.duration: Up to 18 months treatment, 60 months follow-up
